title: DDPM noise schedule, closed form noising and posterior
summary: Build the linear beta schedule and alpha bars, sample x_t from x_0 in closed form, and compute the mean and variance of q(x_{t-1} | x_t, x_0).

mutants.batch_t_not_reshaped: Does not reshape the coefficients for an array of timesteps, so they do not broadcast over the batch.
mutants.no_sqrt: Uses alpha_bar and 1 - alpha_bar as the coefficients of x_t, without the square roots.
mutants.prev_is_current: Uses alpha_bar_t in place of alpha_bar_{t-1} in the posterior.
mutants.prev_wraps_to_last: Builds alpha_bar_{t-1} with np.roll, so t = 0 reads the last step, not 1.
mutants.schedule_misses_end: Divides by T, not by T - 1, so the last beta is below beta_end.
mutants.variance_is_beta: Returns beta_t as the posterior variance, not the tilde beta of the paper.
